## Scope and acceptance criteria

- [ ] Change is focused; unrelated refactoring is avoided.
- [ ] Issue acceptance criteria are met, or any deviations are explained.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.

## Testing

- [ ] Automated tests added or updated for changed behaviour.
- [ ] Relevant build and test commands run locally (list them below).
- [ ] CI checks pass.
- [ ] Manual VM acceptance tests completed, where applicable.
- [ ] If a test is not applicable or could not be run, explain why.

**Commands and results:**

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Networking, permissions, privacy, and security implications considered.
- [ ] No approved security boundary or architecture decision is weakened without explicit review.
- [ ] Existing behaviour remains compatible where applicable.
- [ ] Secrets and credentials are not exposed in logs, diagnostics, or test output.

## Review feedback

- [ ] AI-generated and human review feedback has been triaged.
- [ ] Suggestions were verified against requirements, code, and tests rather than applied blindly.
- [ ] Valid findings are addressed, or a rationale is documented.

## Merge readiness

- [ ] Required checks are complete and passing.
- [ ] PR description reflects the final implementation and test status.
